name: NewMarket (AMPAC)
catalyst: $100m AMPAC expansion approved, >50% capacity increase at Cedar City, UT.
one_liner: The narrowest point in the entire Western missile chain. But AMPAC is ~170 employees inside a petroleum-additives company — the exposure is real and heavily diluted.

name: Toho Titanium
catalyst: Capacity expansion in response to loss of Russian supply.
one_liner: Same 23/25 chokepoint as Osaka Titanium and it has NOT run as hard — but the terminal returned no price for it in this build, so it is unpriced and unrated here. Verify before acting.

name: Osaka Titanium
catalyst: JPY30bn expansion lifting capacity from 40kt to 50kt/yr; running near full.
one_liner: Chokepoint score 23/25 — one of the strongest in the book. Right thesis, wrong entry at +51% YTD.

name: L3Harris (Aerojet Rocketdyne)
catalyst: Missile-business separation/IPO (delayed). >$1bn Orange County VA expansion; $25m Huntsville AMF-South, +130k sqft.
one_liner: Beat and raised on 29 Jul and fell ~7% because missile capex ran +92% YTD. The capex crushing the stock is precisely what creates the 2028+ earnings.

name: Northrop Grumman
catalyst: $178m NAVSEA modular energetics facility at Allegany, doubling SRM capacity by autumn 2026. Sentinel restructuring added $7.6bn to backlog in Q2.
one_liner: Record $105bn backlog at 18.6x — but B-21 carries ~$2.0bn cumulative LRIP losses with $1.0bn accrual remaining. Cheaper than LHX, with fixed-price hair attached.

name: MP Materials
catalyst: DoD bans China-origin magnet material in US military platforms from 2027 — a hard regulatory forcing function.
one_liner: Chokepoint 22/25 and DOWN 18% into a legislated demand mandate. But 198x forward means you are underwriting 2028-2030 magnet volumes and nothing else.

name: Park Aerospace
one_liner: Textbook cheap-but-critical chokepoint (cogs 5/5). Already +59% YTD at 50.6x — the market found this one.

name: IHI
one_liner: The Japanese analogue of the cheap-duopoly idea: 16.9x, flat on the year, +36% to consensus. NOTE: IHI Aerospace's SRM position is well established in industry but was not source-verified in this build — check segment disclosure before sizing.

name: Chemring
catalyst: EUR66.7m of EU funding to double Chemring Nobel explosives capacity.
one_liner: The cleanest listed European energetics asset and unanimous Buy (5.00) — but +27% YTD leaves only ~5% to consensus target. Right thesis, late entry.

name: TDK
catalyst: Ex-China magnet qualification ahead of the 2027 mandate.
one_liner: +38% consensus gap after a +40% run. Same dilution caveat as Shin-Etsu — the magnet slice is small.

name: MACOM Technology
catalyst: Defence RF content growth alongside the AI optics cycle.
one_liner: Rare combination: +47% YTD and still a +59% consensus gap. Also the overlap name with the AI Photonics book — check you are not doubling the position.

name: Carpenter Technology
one_liner: Best-in-class specialty alloy franchise, +65% YTD. Quality is not in question; the multiple is.

name: Karman Holdings
catalyst: Hypersonics & Strategic Missile Defense grew 18.7% YoY in Q1 2026; FY26 guidance raised to $720-735m.
one_liner: The purest listed missile-component bottleneck play, -34% YTD with a +112% consensus gap — but still 72.5x. A sleeve, not a core.

name: Toray Industries
catalyst: Aerospace/defence composite demand; ex-China qualified supply.
one_liner: Cheapest way into the carbon-fibre duopoly at 18.3x vs Hexcel's 38.9x. Defence is a small slice of a large conglomerate — verify segment split before sizing.

name: ATI Inc
one_liner: +63% YTD at 40x with 10% to target. The trade worked; adding here is paying for it twice.

name: Shin-Etsu Chemical
catalyst: 2027 DoD magnet-origin mandate favours qualified ex-China producers.
one_liner: 18.6x with +37% upside and a fortress balance sheet — but the magnet business is a rounding error against PVC and silicon wafers. Indirect exposure.

name: Hexcel
catalyst: Commercial aero recovery plus defence composite demand.
one_liner: +39% YTD and 6% to target. Qualification moat is genuine; the entry point is not.

name: USA Rare Earth
catalyst: 2027 magnet-origin mandate; $7.6bn of US government RE investment since 2025.
one_liner: Unanimous 5.00 rec and +148% to target because there are no earnings to anchor on. Pure option on execution.

name: Hanwha Aerospace
catalyst: ~$1.3bn Pine Bluff Arsenal plant + ~$1bn US modular-charge facility (NC, NG, NQ, triple-base propellant), construction from 2026, full production 2030.
one_liner: Best risk/reward in the theme globally. 15.8x forward, down YTD, unanimous Buy, +87% consensus gap — because Q2 OP missed by ~7% and Gulf orders slipped.

name: Japan Steel Works
catalyst: Japanese defence build-out; forging capacity scarcity.
one_liner: Down on the year with a +54% consensus gap and 4.71 rec. The forging bottleneck at a price the US forging names stopped offering in January.

name: Lockheed Martin
catalyst: THAAD capacity quadrupling (Jan 2026 framework); PrSM to 550/yr; PAC-3 MSE tripled; >$9bn facility programme.
one_liner: The headline trade and the worst expression of it. +20% YTD, 10% to target, and the announcements are money leaving the building. Own the suppliers, not the spender.

name: Renk Group
one_liner: Down 9% at 23.7x with a 4.78 rec and +33% gap. The most interesting European component name, and fully exposed to peace-deal headlines.

name: Curtiss-Wright
one_liner: High-quality compounder at 46.4x. Own it for the franchise, not for this theme.

name: RTX
one_liner: 29.2x for 8.7% upside. Quality prime, no edge at this price.

name: Moog
one_liner: +60% YTD. Excellent qualification moat, fully discovered.

name: Howmet Aerospace
catalyst: Aero build rates plus defence content.
one_liner: 53.5x forward. Superb business, priced as one.

name: Rheinmetall
catalyst: Nitrocellulose vertical integration; Bundeswehr order flow.
one_liner: Owns the energetics layer, down 25%, +39% to target — and is also the single most headline-sensitive stock in the theme. F126 proved German procurement can simply be cancelled.

name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries
catalyst: First-ever export of Japan-built PAC-3 to the US completed 20 Nov 2025 (~10 units per Nikkei). Output ~30/yr with scope to double to ~60 once Boeing seekers clear. PAC-3 MSE and AMRAAM co-production under discussion.
one_liner: A structural policy shift, not a war trade — which is exactly why it survives a peace deal. Expensive at 31.4x; size accordingly.

name: Coherent
one_liner: +50% consensus gap after a +42% YTD run, but the driver is datacentre optics, not munitions. Overlaps the AI Photonics book.

name: Teledyne
one_liner: Reasonably priced at 25.8x for the quality; a compounder, not a bottleneck trade.

name: RBC Bearings
one_liner: Quietly excellent, quietly expensive.

name: Woodward
one_liner: +25% to target at 35x. Solid but not differentiated within this theme.

name: Qorvo
one_liner: 11.5x is the cheapest multiple in the universe, but the rec is 3.10 and the defence slice is small against a handset-driven P&L.

name: Teijin
one_liner: Consensus sees ~1% upside and the rec is 2.67 — the only genuinely negative sell-side stance in this universe.

name: Hanwha Corporation
catalyst: Holdco discount to a re-rating operating chain.
one_liner: 12.6x with a +99% consensus gap and 4.92 rec. The holdco route into the same energetics build-out, cheaper than the opco.

name: Mitsubishi Electric
one_liner: 20.9x with +29% to target and a 4.50 rec. Sane valuation, diluted defence exposure.

name: Hanwha Systems
one_liner: +84% consensus gap, but corrected 64% from its peak — the widest gap between sell-side and tape in the Korean group.

name: Kongsberg Gruppen
catalyst: NSM/JSM export demand; US co-production with Raytheon.
one_liner: Best operational momentum in Europe and +41% YTD to show for it. Excellent company, no discount.

name: BAE Systems
one_liner: Owns genuine energetics capacity, but it is 10% from target after a +24% year. Quality hold, not a fresh entry.

name: Thales
one_liner: The most reasonably valued of the large European electronics primes; still a spending-cycle bet, not a bottleneck.

name: General Dynamics
one_liner: The energetics exposure is genuine but buried. If you want the bottleneck you can buy it more directly elsewhere.

name: MTU Aero Engines
one_liner: Cheapest large European aero name at 19.3x, but this theme is not where its earnings come from.

name: Rolls-Royce
one_liner: Superb turnaround, 35.7x, 8% to target. The re-rating already happened.

name: SGL Carbon
one_liner: Small-cap optionality on European rearmament composites; weak balance sheet is the binding issue, not the thesis.

name: Mercury Systems
one_liner: 69.9x forward for 7% upside. The turnaround is priced.

name: Olin (Winchester)
one_liner: The ammo optionality is real but immaterial against a $2.1bn chlor-alkali cyclical. You are buying a chemicals cycle, not a bottleneck.

name: Boeing
catalyst: Seeker capacity relief would unlock allied PAC-3 volumes.
one_liner: Genuinely sits on a named bottleneck, but you cannot buy the seeker without buying all of Boeing at 175x. Wrong wrapper for the trade.

name: LIG Nex1
catalyst: Middle East and European air-defence exports.
one_liner: The Korean missile pure-play, +62% YTD at 40.3x. The one Korean name that did NOT de-rate — so the margin of safety sits elsewhere in the complex.

name: Dassault Aviation
one_liner: 17.7x with +25% upside — cheapest European prime, but platform-level and export-order dependent.

name: Leonardo DRS
one_liner: Well-run and well-owned at 34.7x. Nothing left to discover.

name: Kratos Defense
catalyst: Record ~$2bn backlog; DoD funding for alternative SRM sources.
one_liner: Raised guidance and fell 39%. A de-rating on valuation and cash burn, not on demand — but 59x still asks a lot before the motor business is proven at scale.

name: Saab
one_liner: 39.3x for 1.8% upside and a 3.60 rec. Fully valued.

name: Hensoldt
one_liner: 48.2x for 5% upside. The European sensor premium has fully arrived.

name: Rocket Lab
catalyst: Golden Dome space-layer sensors and interceptors ($17.5bn FY27, reconciliation-dependent).
one_liner: +80% to target, but the Golden Dome funding it depends on is the single most conditional line in the FY27 request. Overlaps the SpaceX book.

name: SNT Dynamics
one_liner: 10.5x with a unanimous 5.00 rec after a 34% drawdown. Cheapest thing in the book; also the thinnest liquidity.

name: Theon International
one_liner: Good growth and margins; a NATO-budget story rather than a supply-constraint story.

name: Huntington Ingalls
one_liner: Cheap at 17x and down on the year, but shipbuilding labour is a different bottleneck from the one this theme is about.

name: Poongsan
catalyst: None active — Hanwha halted its ~KRW1.5tn acquisition review of the ammunition business in April 2026.
one_liner: Orphaned pure-play ammo asset at -37% YTD. Either the cheapest bottleneck asset in Asia or a value trap; the broken deal removed the obvious re-rating path.

name: Exail Technologies
one_liner: +53% YTD with a 3.50 rec. Real technology, crowded entry.

name: Ducommun
one_liner: The best performer in the theme (+88% YTD) and now 1% from consensus target with the weakest chokepoint score of the US components group. Do not chase.

name: Kawasaki Heavy
one_liner: +44% to target but already +30% YTD, and platform assembly is the widest part of the chain, not the narrowest.

name: Leonardo
one_liner: Reasonable at 19.7x with +26% upside; the MBDA stake is the interesting asset and it is not consolidated.

name: QinetiQ
one_liner: 15.6x is undemanding; services businesses do not hold chokepoints the way materials do.

name: Korea Aerospace Industries
one_liner: 28.6x for an assembler. The least chokepoint-like of the Korean names.

name: AeroVironment
one_liner: -38% YTD with +52% to target, but 45.9x and a chokepoint score of 13 — attritable systems are designed to be cheap and second-sourceable.

name: Hanwha Ocean
one_liner: 13.5x with +70% upside after a 28% drawdown. A different bottleneck (yards and labour) than this theme, included for completeness.

name: Hyundai Rotem
catalyst: European and Middle East tank exports.
one_liner: The largest consensus gap in the entire universe (+127%) at 14.1x — and the weakest chokepoint score (12/25). Cheap for a reason: platform assembly has alternatives.

name: Aperam
one_liner: Cheap at 13.9x, but chokepoint 12/25 — this is a steel cyclical wearing a defence label.
